materiality_analysis.reason: This row references the pointer to Note 2 for details on Non-Arriver businesses. As the primary discontinued operations disclosure is also removed, the removal of the cross-reference to these discontinued business details further signifies the cessation of that reporting stream. While less standalone material than the operations themselves, it contributes to the overall material change in how discontinued items are communicated.

Both serve as navigational pointers within Item 7 to specific numbered notes for further disclosure.
